quotes.text:
**What this PR does / why we need it**:
This is a follow-up PR of PR #56132, which breaks [GCE IP Aliases CI](https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/google-gce#gci-gce-ip-alias).
quotes.author: jingax10
quotes.title: Fix GCE IP Aliases CI https://k8s-testgrid.appspot.com/google-gce#gci-gce-ip-alias failure cause by PR #56132.

medium: The code addresses a CI failure linked to a previous change, requiring synchronization across configuration scripts and fixing a broken test grid.

card.what: This line initializes the `SECONDARY_RANGE_NAME` variable, assigning it an empty string if it hasn't been previously defined.
card.why: The code was added as a fix for a CI failure related to GCE IP aliases. Jing Ai and Jingax10 determined that changes made in `configure-default.sh` (part of PR #56132) needed to be replicated in the `configure-test.sh` script, which is used for continuous integration testing [1][2].
card.next: Before making any changes, verify that the issue of the GCE IP aliases CI failure is still present and that this variable is indeed required for that test.

answer: GCE clusters using IP aliases need SECONDARY_RANGE_NAME; removing it broke the gci-gce-ip-alias job.
